title: NodeBB
name: nodebb
description: Forum software with a modern feel: categories, topics and replies that update live, chat, notifications, groups, Markdown with image uploads, and a plugin and theme library. Source: https://github.com/NodeBB/NodeBB
note: Fill in the database password before you deploy, since the stack won't start without it. Then open http://<your-host>:4567 (or whichever port you picked) straight away, as whoever finishes the installer first makes the admin account. The database is already sorted, so it only asks for the address and an admin login. Keep the address it fills in as the one you'll always open it on, since NodeBB builds its links from it. If you ever need to change it, it's the url in config.json in the nodebb-config volume. Installing takes two or three minutes while it builds, then the forum appears. Anyone who can reach it can read the forum. Sign-ups are open with no email check (change that under Admin --> Settings --> Users), and a new member's first posts wait in the post queue until you approve them. Nothing gets emailed until you set up SMTP under Admin --> Settings --> Email, and browser push notifications need HTTPS. Federation with Mastodon and friends (Admin --> Federation) is on by default, but needs a public HTTPS address to do anything. Plugins you install from the admin panel live in nodebb-modules, uploads in nodebb-uploads, and posts and users in db-data. Docs: docs.nodebb.org
